questions.stem: Purple paint is mixed using red and blue paint in the ratio $2 : 5$. If you use $300\,\text{ml}$ of blue paint, how much red paint do you need?
questions.explanation: Blue corresponds to $5$ parts, so $1$ part $= 300 \div 5 = 60\,\text{ml}$. Red is $2$ parts $= 2 \times 60 = 120\,\text{ml}$.
